question: How much of each salt was dissolved per litre to make the three draw solutions, and to what osmotic pressure?
expect: NaCl 35.0 g/L, MgSO4.7H2O 71.8 g/L, sodium acetate 79.4 g/L, each to 30 bar at 25 C (sec. 2.2)
rendered:
According to the document, the three draw solutions were prepared to provide an initial nominal osmotic pressure of 30 bar at 25 °C, using analytical-grade salts: 

- NaCl (35.0 g L−1)
- MgSO4·7H2O (71.8 g L−1)
- Sodium acetate (79.4 g L−1)

These concentrations were chosen to achieve an initial osmotic pressure of 30 bar for all three draw solutions.
